text: • [[b]]Embers[[/b]] is gained from Ember Shrines built in your settlements.
• Embers increases replenishment, population growth and damage resistance as it grows.
• Embers decreases over time, and from losing battles.
• Your armies may ambush the enemy while attacking. The chance is based on the ground type.
• [[b]]Embers[[/b]] is a resource shared among the Yellow Turban factions.
